Thanks again for the intro call today. Really appreciate the clarity on the use case (loan docs summarization + agent workflows). As promised, here are the key items and suggested next steps so we keep momentum on your side: 

1) Stakeholder map (request): could you confirm the economic buyer and procurement/legal contacts we should expect on the formal review? From our side it helps to know who will sign/approve budgets vs. who will validate security and compliance.

2) Decision criteria: you mentioned latency and PII handling, plus a cost-per-weighted-token metric. Can you confirm the top 3 must-haves for the initial pilot (e.g., <50ms median latency, SOC 2 evidence, per-call encryption)?

3) Champion enablement: I attached a short champion playbook and ROI one-pager we can customize for Carl (economic buyer) and for Legal/Procurement. If you’re up for it, Monica (our sales engineer) and I can prepare two short slides tailored to Carl’s cost-savings framing.

4) Next meeting: propose a 30–45m review with Carl + procurement + legal the week of Apr 19 to align timeline and procurement steps. If that timeline is aggressive, tell us preferred week.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (demo + architecture), redwood-champion-playbook.pdf (champion enablement + talk tracks)

Happy to adjust — want to make internal advocacy as easy as possible for you.

Thanks,
